description: Create a human lab account with an email and password. Mutating: stores a salted password hash and returns a signed session token. Email must be a valid address, password at least 8 characters; duplicate emails are rejected. Use for a human seat; use spl_agent_key for a passwordless agent key.

email.description: Account email address. Must be a valid email; duplicates are rejected with email_taken.

name.description: Display name, up to 80 characters. Defaults to the part of the email before @.

password.description: Account password, at least 8 characters. Stored as a salted hash, never in plain text.

name: spl_signup
